mapper.select: SELECT es.id AS stageId, es.title AS title, es.description AS description, es.order_number AS orderNumber, CASE WHEN sc.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS isCompleted, em.id AS materialId, em.title AS materialTitle, em.video_url AS videoUrl, COALESCE(vp.watched_position, 0) AS lastWatchedPosition FROM education_stages es LEFT JOIN stage_completions sc ON sc.stage_id = es.id AND sc.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN education_materials em ON em.stage_id = es.id LEFT JOIN video_progress vp ON vp.material_id = em.id AND vp.user_id = #{userId} WHERE es.education_id = #{educationId} ORDER BY es.order_number ASC
